papers.title: PagedWeight: Efficient MoE LLM Serving with Dynamic Quality-Aware Weight Quantization
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a popular class of large language models (LLMs), offering high efficiency and accuracy. However, in KV-cache-intensive serving scenarios, MoEs often exhibit a tension between the GPU memory requirements of the model weights and the growing KV cache. We propose PagedWeight, a novel management method for MoE LLM serving that dynamically quantizes MoE model's weights at runtime and balances expert-weight precision with the KV cache sizes. papers.llm_reason: PagedWeight（Yang/Zhao/Dasgupta/Misailovic，UIUC 量化/系统组）直击 MoE LLM 推理服务最痛的内存矛盾：在 KV-cache 密集场景下，专家权重与不断增长的 KV cache 争抢 GPU 显存。论文→理论层面，它把'权重精度'从静态超参重构为运行时可调的资源杠杆——按需动态量化专家权重、用省下的显存换更大的 KV cache 窗口，实质是用'精度换容量'的帕累托调度；工程实践层面，该方法可直接嵌入任何 vLLM/SGLang 类 MoE 推理框架：在长上下文/高并发场景下，默认让冷门专家走低精度、热门专家走高精度，并把回收的显存还给 KV cache 池，从而在不加 GPU 的前提下提升可服务并发数与最大上下文长度；趋势层面，2026 年 MoE 已成主流架构（DeepSeek/Mixtral/Qwen-MoE），但'显存墙'取代'算力墙'成为服务瓶颈，精度-显存动态权衡是明确上升线。证据为方法设计与系统抽象自述（质量感知量化），工程目标（权重精度 vs KV cache 大小的平衡）清晰可验证。短板：无代码/benchmark 链接（待核验），动态量化的精度损失阈值、量化/反量化的运行时开销、与具体 MoE 模型的吞吐提升幅度均为关键待验项。在今日数据中落地性最强，故评为即时价值。

papers.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its value for reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training remains unclear. We study vanilla Muon in sparse-reward agentic RL through matched single-seed comparisons with AdamW on ALFWorld using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. Under Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), applying Muon only to hidden weight matrices raises final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546 (+88%); high-rate AdamW controls retain no post-update success. papers.llm_reason: When Does Muon Help Agentic RL?（Ruan/Lin/Huang/Zhou/Wei）回答了一个高度实操的问题：在稀疏奖励的 Agentic RL 后训练中，Muon 优化器相比 AdamW 到底有没有用？论文→理论层面，它把'Muon vs AdamW'的争论从'预训练阶段（Muon 已证明有竞争力）'推进到'后训练/RL 阶段（尚不清晰）'，并给出有对照的实证——在 ALFWorld 上用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct + GiGPO，仅对隐藏权重矩阵施用 Muon 使验证成功率从 0.290 提升到 0.546（+88%），而高学习率 AdamW 对照组训练后成功率为零；工程实践层面，这对任何做 Agent RL 后训练的团队都是即插即用的实验线索：可立即在自有的 RLHF/Agentic RL 流水线上对照 Muon（仅 2D 权重）vs AdamW，验证收益是否可复现、是否随模型规模保持；趋势层面，优化器选择是 RL 后训练工程化的基础杠杆，且'仅对特定权重矩阵用 Muon'这种选择性策略本身是一种可迁移的训练工程模式。证据为单种子对照实验、具体数字、具体模型/基准，透明度高（虽为单种子，需多种子确认）。短板：无代码链接（待核验），0.5B 规模的结论能否外推到更大模型、多种子方差、其他 Agent 基准上的表现均为关键待验项。落地路径清晰且证据具体，评为即时价值。

papers.title: An Exam for Active Observers
papers.abstract: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML
papers.llm_reason: An Exam for Active Observers / ActiveVision（Zhang/Tao/Wang/Liu/Ma，USC）指出当前多模态大模型（MLLM）评测的根本盲点：人类视觉是闭环的——注视方向由中间假设持续引导，而非单次快照；现有视觉-语言 benchmark 无法测量 MLLM 是否真正'主动观察'。论文→理论层面，它把'主动观察'从认知科学命题转化为可度量的 benchmark 维度，填补'静态单帧理解'与'闭环多步感知'之间的评测空白；工程实践层面，对自建多模态 Agent 评测流水线有直接参考：应检查系统是否在'需要主动调整观察（多帧/多区域聚焦）才能解决的任务'上失败，而当前依赖单帧快照的评测会掩盖这类缺陷；趋势层面，多模态评测正从'被动识别'走向'主动感知/闭环交互'，2026 年是关键方法论转型期。证据为 benchmark 设计自述，方法论清晰。短板：无代码/benchmark 链接（待核验），任务集规模、与现有 benchmark 的区分度、人类基线表现均为待验项。方法论价值高但需等待资产开源验证，评为趋势价值。

papers.title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Generating Structured Threat Information for Autonomous Vehicle Vulnerabilities
papers.abstract: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) rely on interconnected software and hardware components, including sensors, Electronic Control Units, in-vehicle infotainment systems, and telematics units, where vulnerabilities can compromise assets, users, and vehicle operations. papers.title: Physics-enhanced reinforcement learning for real-time optimal control of dynamical systems
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising feedback control strategy for nonlinear and complex dynamical systems.
